name: Symbiote
description: «We will blow up your turret, and then your track, and then rip off your paint right off your tank. You will become a turretless, trackless, paintless...» (c) Owner of the paint
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on 4th October 2018, as part of a special offer in the shop for 38.99 USD.
From 4-15th of October, the paint remained for purchase in the Shop exclusively, after which it was added into containers.
